text.en:
There shall be established a school of fisheries in the Municipality of Gumaca, Province of
Quezon, to be known as the Lamon Bay School of Fisheries.

The amount of three hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, the sums necessary of the same purpose shall be included in the annual
General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
